metadata.title: Botswana rural electrification and verified mini-grid pilot set

sources.title: Committee of Supply Speech - March 2025
sources.facts: 463 of 565 villages electrified; six remote villages selected for an off-grid pilot.

sources.title: Botswana Power Corporation Electricity Generation Update
sources.facts: 83% of gazetted villages have access; six villages identified for off-grid electrification.

sources.title: Botswana Off Grid Project - Small Scale Mini-Grid Solar PV Plants
sources.facts: Names six pilot villages and describes four mini-grid plants.

metadata.coordinate_note: Village coordinates are public gazetteer/OSM coordinates used only for spatial screening. They are not BPC connection points.
metadata.coverage_note: The public sources identify the six pilot villages, but do not provide a verified current public list of every village that remains unconnected. GridIQ therefore ships a verified pilot cohort, not a fabricated 102-village list.

known_data_conflicts.issue: A public off-grid project document states each pilot village is over 100 km from existing grid infrastructure, while a March 2025 parliamentary report says Ukhwi is 63 km from the actual connection point at Ncojane.
known_data_conflicts.handling: GridIQ does not hard-code a single distance. It computes distance to mapped OSM power infrastructure when available and shows both public statements as context.
